description: OrbitX-Astra aims to develop the understanding of the Great Universe beyond our Planet Earth to astronauts, engineers, students and even kids!
summary:
RED HORIZON: BEYOND is a first-person 3D Mars exploration and astronaut mission-training game designed to introduce younger audiences to the challenges of living and working on Mars.

Players take the role of an astronaut stationed on Mars, where they explore the environment, complete mission objectives, manage essential resources, and respond to environmental hazards. Across three Martian sols (days), players experience mission progression and face challenges such as surviving a simulated Martian dust storm by finding shelter.

Developed using Godot Engine 4.7.2 and GDScript, the project combines interactive 3D environments, mission systems, survival mechanics, and atmospheric effects.

Our goal is to make planetary science and space exploration more engaging and accessible through interactive gameplay. Rather than simply reading about Mars, players experience some of the challenges future astronauts may encounter.

The team considered educational value, scientific relevance, accessibility, hardware performance, and gameplay experience throughout development. Ultimately, RED HORIZON: BEYOND aims to inspire curiosity about Mars, STEM, and humanity's future in space.
details: RED HORIZON: BEYOND is a first-person 3D Mars exploration game that puts players in the role of a junior astronaut. Explore the Martian surface, complete missions, manage essential resources, and survive environmental hazards across three Martian sols. Featuring interactive gameplay, mission progression, and simulated dust storms, the game aims to make Mars exploration engaging and introduce younger audiences to the challenges of future space missions.
